prospectiveAnalysisRemediation.scope: Applies to future analysis only; it does not recompute, alter, or relabel frozen study rows, navigation observations, costs, grades, or frozenAnalyzerGate records.
changes: Parser freshness now verifies deployed pinned runtime and grammar bytes on every extraction snapshot instead of trusting cached manifest declarations.
Non-completed participant rows block the release gate and are excluded from paired completion and rubric inference while preserving raw grades and usage accounting.
Completion estimates require completed, graded left/right results from the same repeat.
Future analyzer gates distinguish navigation measurement absent from measured first-useful navigation without improvement.

mappingCosts.breakEvenStatus: Unavailable until complete mapping cost and positive measured downstream savings exist.

limitations: Four synthetic corpora, not sampled production repositories. Hosted coverage: one Python pilot testing task, one Python confirmatory planning task with five arms, one TypeScript planning task with legacy arm only.
Five contaminated rows retain original grades and usage; canonical quality is null. One token pair per comparison is descriptive only, with zero valid paired quality grades.
Navigation budgets are UTF-8 bytes, not tokens. Script reads whole semantic JSON shards; failures do not establish that all possible ordinary-file navigation strategies fail.

The frozen analyzer reason navigation-evidence-unmeasured conflates absent measurement with measured lack of improvement; the explicit navigationDecision is measured true, improvement false. This does not alter the failed gate.
Observed source-read classifier cannot classify batched shell reads; zero classified reads is not zero actual reads. Hidden model memory is not measured.
Full mapping lifecycle, refresh attribution, monetary cost, and break-even are unavailable. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets, not extra totals.

Participant workspace separation was prompt-based, not technically enforced. One participant escaped the workspace and retried a rejected write through shell; launches stopped, evidence preserved, main checkout restored. No further study participants launched.
One fixer exceeded its initial 750000-token reserve by 54636 tokens. Actual usage retained; caps were never reset. No provider hard cap was available.
